generate_ogb_code2_dataset: run the script to generate the OGB Code2 dataset as sharded NPZ files with graph tuples
convert_to_graphs_tuple: convert a raw OGB Code2 graph dictionary into a Jraph GraphsTuple with eigendecomposition
process_graph_with_config: process a graph by filtering control flow and next syntax edges then computing MAG eigenvalues
encode_raw_target: encode a list of target strings into a UTF-8 byte array for dataset storage
generate_dataflow_dataset: run the script with data flow mode to parse Python code into data-flow centric graphs
